question.en: Discuss the role of the World Health Organization in strengthening global health security and its relevance to the Indian economy.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the World Health Organization in strengthening global health security and its relevance to the Indian economy.

modelAnswer.en: The WHO sets global standards, provides technical support, and coordinates responses to health crises. For India, WHO's guidance is crucial for strengthening primary healthcare, managing non-communicable diseases, and improving health infrastructure, which directly impacts labor productivity and economic stability.
